lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.focus: applied right-triangle modeling with units and accuracy
lessonRef.title: Guided practice B: applied right-triangle modeling with units and accuracy

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Read once, then cover the example and try the guided set from memory.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: From a point 4 m from the base of a tower, the angle of elevation to the top is θ, and the tower is 3 m tall. Which equation correctly determines θ?
A right triangle has legs 3 and 4 and hypotenuse 5. Angle θ is opposite the leg of length 3. Find tan θ as an exact fraction in lowest terms.
A right triangle has hypotenuse 75 and one leg 21. Find the other leg.
Express sin 33° as a cosine of another angle, and explain why the two are equal.
choices: cos 147°, because the angles are supplementary
cos 57°, because the two angles are complementary and swap the roles of opposite and adjacent
cos 123°, because the angles differ by a right angle
cos 33°, because sine and cosine are always equal

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: From a point 8 m from the base of a tower, the angle of elevation to the top is θ, and the tower is 6 m tall. Which equation correctly determines θ?
A right triangle has legs 9 and 40 and hypotenuse 41. Angle θ is opposite the leg of length 9. Find cos θ as an exact fraction in lowest terms.
A right triangle has legs 15 and 36. Find the hypotenuse.
Express sin 39° as a cosine of another angle, and explain why the two are equal.
choices: cos 39°, because sine and cosine are always equal
cos 129°, because the angles differ by a right angle
cos 51°, because the two angles are complementary and swap the roles of opposite and adjacent
cos 141°, because the angles are supplementary

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.
